subject.title: Fix auth_profile_store not resyncing when apiKey is updated in openclaw.json

question: When a configured provider API key conflicts with its bound SQLite auth profile, should OpenClaw retain SQLite authority until an explicit `openclaw doctor --fix`, or should configuration automatically become authoritative?
rationale: The proposed patch deliberately avoids changing request-time precedence, while the linked report requests behavior that makes a post-edit key take effect without manual database intervention. That authority contract affects existing credentials and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Accept explicit Doctor repair
options.body: Keep SQLite authoritative, land restart/Doctor warnings, and make `openclaw doctor --fix` the documented opt-in migration path.

options.title: Make config authoritative
options.body: Revise the runtime and migration contract so an updated configured key takes precedence or is migrated through a clearly defined upgrade flow.

options.title: Defer the contract change
options.body: Keep the linked issue open for a broader credential-authority design before accepting behavior that may be interpreted as resolving it.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit Doctor repair
recommendation.body: Keep SQLite authoritative, land restart/Doctor warnings, and make `openclaw doctor --fix` the documented opt-in migration path.
